Karl Stefanovic isn’t the only Australian over in London playing footsie with the far right.

Several other Australian political figures were at Jordan Peterson’s Alliance for Responsible Citizenship conference last week, including Barnaby Joyce, Scott Morrison, Tony Abbott and Peta Credlin, to name but a few members of this nightmare blunt rotation.

Also on the roster was Nationals Senator Bridget McKenzie — curious, given last week was a sitting week, and she is apparently still her party’s leader in the Senate.
